entry.title: Europe is Winning Over Young People!

media:group.media:title: Europe is Winning Over Young People!
media:group.media:description:
On May 9, Europe shouldn’t just be something we talk about, it should be something we experience. We’ve gathered a list of free events happening across Europe for Europe Day 🇪🇺 If you want to celebrate, meet people, and see what Europe is all about beyond the headlines, take a look: 👉 https://culturalfoundation.eu/calendar/
This video explores why young Europeans are increasingly optimistic about the European Union, backed by fresh data and voices from across the continent. From economic strength and new trade deals to democratic change in countries like Hungary and Romania, it shows how the EU is shaping real outcomes on the ground. It also dives into key issues like security, climate action, and the growing demand for stronger European cooperation, especially in places like Poland and Netherlands. At the same time, the video doesn’t shy away from the EU’s challenges, from unfinished integration to political divisions. Ultimately, it’s a personal and continent-wide story about why Europe still matters—and why a new generation is starting to believe in it again.

entry.title: The European Alternatives To YouTube, WhatsApp & Instagram

media:group.media:title: The European Alternatives To YouTube, WhatsApp & Instagram
media:group.media:description:
Go to https://ground.news/EUMS to stay fully informed on the EU and more with news made simple. Subscribe through my link to save 40% on unlimited access.
Europe uses American apps for almost everything. YouTube. Instagram. WhatsApp. TikTok. Even the software used to create this video. But what happens when the platforms shaping European public opinion, communication, and culture are all controlled outside Europe? In this video, we explore Europe’s growing dependence on U.S. and Chinese social media platforms, why governments across Europe are starting to push back, and whether Europe can realistically build its own digital giants. From WhatsApp alternatives like Olvid and Threema, to new European social platforms like BeReal and Monnet, we look at the future of European digital sovereignty, data security, and the geopolitical power of social media.

entry.title: Never Again: How the EU can build a VETO-proof system

media:group.media:title: Never Again: How the EU can build a VETO-proof system
media:group.media:description:
The EU still relies on unanimity in key areas like foreign policy, taxation, and enlargement, meaning a single country can block decisions with a veto. To move forward, this could shift toward Qualified Majority Voting (QMV), or even a stricter super QMV system, reducing the power of individual holdouts. But changing this isn’t simple. It requires treaty reform, agreement among member states, and in some cases national referendums. The real question is whether Europe is ready to trade sovereignty for efficiency, and to finally act like a superpower.

Europe has more than 30 stock exchanges, yet none can compete with the scale of the United States’ financial giants. As a result, many of Europe’s most successful companies choose to list in New York, taking investment, innovation and wealth with them. Around €300 billion in European savings flows to the US every year, highlighting how fragmented Europe’s capital markets really are.
